create_random_image_dataset: create a RandomImageDataset with configurable crop size, channels, classes, and sample count
create_random_binary_class_dataset: create a RandomImageBinaryClassDataset with a configurable class imbalance ratio for binary classification
format_sample_with_get_typed_sample: format an input target pair as a dict tuple or list using _get_typed_sample
use_sampletype_enum: use the SampleType enum to choose dict tuple or list output format for dataset samples
generate_random_image_sample: generate a single random image sample with a target label using RandomImageDataset getitem
